📖 HOW TO PLAY BELT PANIC!

🏃‍♂️

1. The Belt Rush

Rush to the central pedestal when the match starts! First to pick up the belt becomes the HUNTER.

☀️

2. Lights ON: Hunt!

The Hunter chases survivors and swings with Left Click to tag and stun them for points!

🌑

3. Blackout: Steal!

Lights turn OFF! Survivors sneak close to the Hunter and hold [E] for 1 second to steal the belt!

⚠️

4. Lights Return!

Buzzer sounds! Lights slam ON, revealing the new Hunter! The cycle repeats until the match ends.

CONTROLS: [W,A,S,D] Move • [SPACE] Jump • [MOUSE] Look • [LEFT CLICK] Belt Swing • [HOLD E] Steal Belt
